# Future steps

## Making the Lotka-Voltera Predator Prey Model more realistic

As an exercise, can you think of ways to make the model more realistic? This could be a good way to practice differential equation modeling. For example, consider the assumptions we made in the model:

1. Prey grow exponentially. (In reality, the population growth of rabbits is probably limited by available vegetation.)

2. The consumption of prey increases linearly with prey density. (In reality, predators can become satiated.)

## Moving to other ODE models

There is a lot of similarity between the Lotka–Volterra predator–prey model and the epidemic model (also known as the SIR model). Notably, the rate at which individuals are infected is also governed by the Law of Mass Action.
